original_evidence.text: | D-Fend Reloaded (DOSBox frontend/launcher) | https://github.com/osgamearchive/D-Fend-Reloaded.git (source-release mirror of the SourceForge project; archived) | ab7975a / 2019-08-06 | Y | Y (`VersionSpecificUpdateCheck` defaults `True`; `ProgramUpdateCheckUnit.pas:135` `RunUpdateCheckIfSetup`) | Y | **plaintext HTTP** | N | **none** | n/a | `Tools/UpdateCheck/UpdateCheck.txt:2`: update-info URL is `http://home.tu-clausthal.de/~ifalh/UpdateInfo.txt` (plain HTTP, not HTTPS); `Tools/UpdateCheck/UpdateCheck.nsi:161-196`: downloads `UpdateInfoFile` via `inetc::get` over that HTTP URL, parses `$ServerVersion`/`$UpdateFileURL` from it, downloads the installer to `$SetupTempFile`, then `Exec '"$SetupTempFile" /A /D=$UpdateInstallDir'` — no hash or signature check anywhere in the chain before executing the downloaded installer. Worst-case pattern: on-path attacker on plain HTTP can serve an arbitrary "update" and it is auto-executed |
